messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: inference-path p99 spike detected (eu-west-1). Alerts: p95 230ms -> 1.2s, p99 380ms -> 3.1s, streaming tail counts rising. Triggered automated page to oncall.
Liam (oncall): I'm on it. Quick ask — is it global or regional?
incident-bot: Affected hosts: inference-gateway-eu-{2..5}. Downstream hints: auth token-store DB showing elevated 95th/99th latency and featureflag service timeouts. Rate limiter alarms also seen.
Maya (sre): seeing same in dashboards. Auth DB read latencies spike coincident with background job window. Streaming stall rate up ~6% of active connections in eu-west-1.
Jorge (runtime): streaming stalls look like `WAIT_KV` on the gateway logs — credentials check path waiting on token validation. Snip: ```[2026-03-15T09:07:12Z] GET /v1/stream -> wait auth: token-validate latency 2200ms```
Tara (infra): I can check DB replica lag and connection pool exhaustion. Pushing up DB pool metrics now.
Ben (db): DB margin is fine for normal qps but there's a hotkey pattern hitting token-store table: repeated small selects from same token ids (session refresh storms).
Liam (oncall): customer impact? Alex?
Alex (cs): A few customers on Dedicated are reporting streaming stalls and partial failures; public hosted customers show increased retries but no widespread 5xx yet. CNX-47 and ACME corp reported delays.
Nina (product): ACME is mid-commit for a demo in 2 hours — need mitigation asap, even if temporary.
Maya (sre): Mitigation plan: 1) Short-circuit feature-flag checks for inference path (toggle off remote check), 2) enable local token cache on gateways (increase TTL), 3) throttle background refresh jobs. Can someone flip the feature flag?
Jorge (runtime): I can enable local cache on the gateway config and bump TTL to 30s. Applying as hot config now to a canary host. Command: ```kubectl patch deploy/gateway-eu-2 -n prod --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/2/value","value":"30"}]'```
deploy-bot: Starting rollout to gateway-eu-2 (deploy id: d-8791). Watch: https://deploys.redwood/teams/runtime/d-8791
Tara (infra): DB team, can you add a read-only connection for token-store from eu-west read replica to reduce primary qps?
Ben (db): Spawning a new read pool + connection string for gateways in eu-west. SQL to create replica user run: ```CREATE USER gw_ro WITH PASSWORD '***'; GRANT SELECT ON token_store TO gw_ro;``` Propagating creds to vault now.
Liam (oncall): Jorge, after you canary the TTL change, please roll to remaining gateways but do it slow. Watch p99 and streaming stall rate.
Jorge (runtime): Canary looks good on eu-2 after 2m. p99 down to ~450ms there. Rolling to eu-3, eu-4 (serial).
Maya (sre): Also recommend short-term exception in rate limiter for featureflag calls from gateway service to avoid cascading retries. We can restore strict limits after cure.
Tara (infra): Applied limiter exception for service id `gateway-service` (rule id rl-301). Monitor for token-store qps.
Nina (product): Will notify affected customers with ETA and mitigation notes. Alex take lead on comms.
Alex (cs): On it — sending scripted note: "We're experiencing transient streaming stalls in eu-west-1 related to auth validation. We're applying a temporary cache/flag change and expect improved latency within 30 minutes."
Maya (sre): Observability note — enable detailed traces for auth path for next 10m: ```/ops/traces?svc=auth&sample=1.0``` toggled.
Ben (db): After limiter exception and read replica onboard, primary qps dropped 62% for token_store. Latency reduced to p99 ~380ms cluster-wide.
Liam (oncall): Good. Can we get streaming stall rate down under 1% before we declare mitigation effective?
Jorge (runtime): roll complete. EU gateways rolled in ~8m. p99 now ~270-300ms, streaming stall rate down to 0.9%.
deploy-bot: Rollout completed for d-8791 to eu-3, eu-4. No failed pods.
Maya (sre): Recommend postmortem actions: 1) introduce local token cache by default in gateway, 2) hotspot detection for token-store hotkeys, 3) circuit-breaker + fallback for featureflag service, 4) increase replica coverage in eu region.
Tara (infra): I'll schedule a capacity bump and add autoscaling rule for token-store read replicas.
Ben (db): Will add hotkey index and an expiring token cache layer in front of token_store.
Priya (oncall-next): I'll take a proper handoff at 10:30 UTC with all runbook notes.
Liam (oncall): Thanks team. Declaring active mitigation successful, monitoring for 45m before full close. Leaving notes in the incident doc.
Alex (cs): Sent customer updates. Will follow up with ACME directly.
Nina (product): Filing a high-priority experiment to ensure featureflag short-circuit isn't used for more than 30m in production without follow-up.
Maya (sre): Adding timeline and metrics to incident tracker. Closing thread here; Priya you have the handoff.
Priya (oncall-next): Taking handoff. I'll ping if anything regresses. :thumbsup:
